The Framework

The SPANCO Sales System

Most businesses track only two stages: Enquiry and Order. That is why opportunities disappear without clear action. With SPANCO, you will learn to manage every sales opportunity systematically.

S
Suspect
P
Prospect
A
Approach
N
Negotiation
C
Closure
O
Order

When every opportunity has a stage, owner and next action, sales becomes measurable — and manageable.
